from solution import max_product
import inspect


def test_issue_example_given():
    """Example: max_product([3, 100, 4, 5, 150, 6], 6) == 45000."""
    assert max_product([3, 100, 4, 5, 150, 6], 6) == 45000  # 3*100*150 = 45000


def test_issue_single_element():
    """Single-element array returns that element as the maximum product."""
    assert max_product([7], 1) == 7  # only subsequence [7] = 7


def test_issue_all_increasing():
    """Fully increasing array multiplies all elements together."""
    assert max_product([1, 2, 3, 4], 4) == 24  # 1*2*3*4 = 24


def test_issue_all_decreasing():
    """Fully decreasing array has no increasing pair so picks largest singleton."""
    assert max_product([5, 4, 3, 2, 1], 5) == 5  # max(5,4,3,2,1) = 5


def test_issue_two_increasing():
    """Two increasing elements multiply together."""
    assert max_product([2, 3], 2) == 6  # 2*3 = 6


def test_issue_two_decreasing():
    """Two decreasing elements pick the larger singleton."""
    assert max_product([3, 2], 2) == 3  # max(3,2) = 3


def test_issue_singleton_beats_pair():
    """Early large singleton beats later smaller increasing pair."""
    assert max_product([10, 2, 3], 3) == 10  # max(10, 2*3=6) = 10


def test_issue_skip_middle_peak():
    """Skipping a middle peak gives larger product than including it."""
    assert max_product([2, 3, 10, 4, 5], 5) == 120  # 2*3*4*5 = 120


def test_issue_zero_is_skipped():
    """Zero subsequence is skipped when a larger positive product exists."""
    assert max_product([0, 1, 2], 3) == 2  # 1*2 = 2


def test_issue_negative_start():
    """Increasing subsequence starting negative picks best positive product."""
    assert max_product([-2, 1, 2, 3], 4) == 6  # 1*2*3 = 6, also 2*3 = 6


def test_contract_accepts_two_arguments():
    """Contract: max_product(arr, n) takes array and length."""
    sig = inspect.signature(max_product)
    assert len(sig.parameters) == 2


def test_contract_deterministic():
    """Contract: max_product(arr, n) returns same result on repeated calls."""
    first = max_product([3, 100, 4, 5, 150, 6], 6)  # 3*100*150 = 45000
    second = max_product([3, 100, 4, 5, 150, 6], 6)  # 3*100*150 = 45000
    assert first == second == 45000  # 3*100*150 = 45000
